findings.rule: A09:2021 - Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
findings.message: Full request object logged including sensitive PII fields (customer_email, card_number). This violates data protection requirements.
findings.suggestion: Mask or remove sensitive fields before logging. Log only payment_id and amount.

findings.message: No explicit input length validation on 'card_number' field. Could accept malformed input.
findings.suggestion: Add input length and format validation for card_number (e.g., 13-19 digits).
Add security headers middleware to the FastAPI application.
